bindings.description: Single alleged shop-subletting arrangement between the appellant tenant and Sohan Singh. The respondent landlord alleged that the appellant sub-let the entire shop and charged Sohan Singh rent; the appellant admitted her underlying tenancy, denied subletting, asserted that Sohan Singh was her husband and described their involvement in the chemist business. Prior courts found no subletting on the husband-wife account. The allegations, denials, business-use account, described evidence and prior findings concern the same alleged arrangement, not separate transactions.
